head: Gemini Notebook website maker turns your notes into interactive sites
dek: Gemini Notebook can now build a small interactive site from the sources in a notebook, such as a periodic table to study with, a timeline, a data dashboard or a project tracker. It's rolling out worldwide on the web for users 18 and over, Workspace subscribers included.
details: In a notebook's chat you type "make me a site" and describe what you want. When it's built, you can open it in a new tab or share it with others. Google says the mobile app gets it soon.
where: Gemini Notebook on the web, worldwide, 18+; mobile app later
means: If you study or plan projects in Gemini Notebook, you can turn your notes into something you click through instead of reading another summary.
todo: Open a notebook on the web, type "make me a site" in its chat and say what it should show. Check the facts on the site against your sources before you share it.
